contentIds.title: Item ids sent to the pixels
contentIds.description: Product: each item's product id. Variant: its variant id (the product id when it has none), for catalogs that list each variant on its own.

searchFromUrl.title: Searches found in the page address go to the pixels
searchFromUrl.description: On: a search results page (an address with one of your search parameters, set in Searches and 404s) also sends a Search event to the pixels. Off: only the searches your code sends (SSGrowth.search or ss:search) go to them; Searches and 404s still records both.
